scripts.check:wiring: npm run check:fast && tsci check netlist && tsci check schematic-placement
scripts.check:full: npm run check:wiring && tsci build --disable-parts-engine && npm run check:vias && tsci check shorts
scripts.export:gerbers: mkdir -p dist && tsci export index.circuit.tsx -f gerbers --disable-parts-engine -o dist/gerbers.zip
scripts.export:images: tsci build --disable-parts-engine --pcb-png --3d-png && mkdir -p docs/images && cp dist/index/pcb.png dist/index/3d.png docs/images/
